warframes.name: Ash Prime
warframes.description: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Atlas Prime
warframes.description: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.

warframes.name: Banshee Prime
warframes.description: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Baruuk Prime
warframes.description: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.

warframes.name: Caliban Prime
warframes.description: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.

warframes.name: Chroma Prime
warframes.description: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Ember Prime
warframes.description: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.

warframes.name: Equinox Prime
warframes.description: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.

warframes.name: Excalibur Prime
warframes.description: Excalibur Prime is the epitome of mobility and offense, and features the same abilities as Excalibur, but has unique mod polarities installed allowing for greater customization.

warframes.name: Frost Prime
warframes.description: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.

warframes.name: Gara Prime
warframes.description: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.

warframes.name: Garuda Prime
warframes.description: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.

warframes.name: Gauss Prime
warframes.description: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.

warframes.name: Grendel Prime
warframes.description: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.

warframes.name: Harrow Prime
warframes.description: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.

warframes.name: Hildryn Prime
warframes.description: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline's reward.

warframes.name: Hydroid Prime
warframes.description: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Inaros Prime
warframes.description: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Ivara Prime
warframes.description: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.

warframes.name: Khora Prime
warframes.description: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.

warframes.name: Lavos Prime
warframes.description: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.

warframes.name: Limbo Prime
warframes.description: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Loki Prime
warframes.description: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Mag Prime
warframes.description: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Mesa Prime
warframes.description: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Mirage Prime
warframes.description: Dazzle the opposition with this golden master of illusion and mayhem. Featuring altered mod polarities allow for greater customization.

warframes.name: Nekros Prime
warframes.description: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities allow for greater customization.

warframes.name: Nezha Prime
warframes.description: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Nidus Prime
warframes.description: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.

warframes.name: Nova Prime
warframes.description: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Nyx Prime
warframes.description: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Oberon Prime
warframes.description: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Octavia Prime
warframes.description: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Protea Prime
warframes.description: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.

warframes.name: Revenant Prime
warframes.description: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.

warframes.name: Rhino Prime
warframes.description: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.

warframes.name: Saryn Prime
warframes.description: A golden blossom conceals deadly nectar. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Sevagoth Prime
warframes.description: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.

warframes.name: Sevagoth Prime's Shadow
warframes.description: When the Tempestarii became a void phantom, Sevagoth set aside his body and became a Shadow, to continue his solemn duty of saving lives.

warframes.name: Titania Prime
warframes.description: Tempting and terrifying, this is Titania in her ultimate form.

warframes.name: Trinity Prime
warframes.description: Become the bastion that defends allies using powerful healing abilities with Trinity Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Valkyr Prime
warframes.description: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities allow for greater customization.

warframes.name: Vauban Prime
warframes.description: Transform the battlefield into a weapon with this gilded tactician. Features unique mod polarities for extended customization.

warframes.name: Volt Prime
warframes.description: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.name: Wisp Prime
warframes.description: Wisp Prime's gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.

warframes.name: Wukong Prime
warframes.description: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.

warframes.name: Xaku Prime
warframes.description: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.

warframes.name: Yareli Prime
warframes.description: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.

warframes.name: Zephyr Prime
warframes.description: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.

warframes.name: Ash
warframes.description: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.

warframes.name: Atlas
warframes.description: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.

warframes.name: Banshee
warframes.description: Banshee's call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.

warframes.name: Baruuk
warframes.description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.

warframes.name: Caliban
warframes.description: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.

warframes.name: Chroma
warframes.description: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.

warframes.name: Citrine
warframes.description: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.

warframes.name: Cyte-09
warframes.description: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.

warframes.name: Dagath
warframes.description: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.

warframes.name: Dante
warframes.description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.

warframes.name: Ember
warframes.description: Harness the power of fire. Ember's heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.

warframes.name: Equinox
warframes.description: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.

warframes.name: Excalibur
warframes.description: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.

warframes.name: Excalibur Umbra
warframes.description: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.

warframes.name: Frost
warframes.description: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost's attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.

warframes.name: Gara
warframes.description: Enemies are made fragile by Gara's deadly touch. Gara's vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.

warframes.name: Garuda
warframes.description: Death's crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.

warframes.name: Gauss
warframes.description: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.

warframes.name: Grendel
warframes.description: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.

warframes.name: Gyre
warframes.description: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre's electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.

warframes.name: Harrow
warframes.description: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.

warframes.name: Hildryn
warframes.description: Strength is Hildryn's virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.

warframes.name: Hydroid
warframes.description: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.

warframes.name: Inaros
warframes.description: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.

warframes.name: Ivara
warframes.description: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.

warframes.name: Jade
warframes.description: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.

warframes.name: Khora
warframes.description: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.

warframes.name: Koumei
warframes.description: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.

warframes.name: Kullervo
warframes.description: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.

warframes.name: Lavos
warframes.description: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.

warframes.name: Limbo
warframes.description: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.

warframes.name: Loki
warframes.description: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.

warframes.name: Mag
warframes.description: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.

warframes.name: Mesa
warframes.description: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.

warframes.name: Mirage
warframes.description: Mirage's sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.

warframes.name: Nekros
warframes.description: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.

warframes.name: Nezha
warframes.description: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha's multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.

warframes.name: Nidus
warframes.description: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.

warframes.name: Nokko
warframes.description: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you

warframes.name: Nova
warframes.description: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.

warframes.name: Nyx
warframes.description: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.

warframes.name: Oberon
warframes.description: Healing and suffering do Oberon's bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.

warframes.name: Octavia
warframes.description: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy's destruction.

warframes.name: Oraxia
warframes.description: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.

warframes.name: Protea
warframes.description: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.

warframes.name: Qorvex
warframes.description: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.

warframes.name: Revenant
warframes.description: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.

warframes.name: Rhino
warframes.description: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.

warframes.name: Saryn
warframes.description: Toxicity is Saryn's strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.

warframes.name: Sevagoth
warframes.description: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.

warframes.name: Sevagoth's Shadow
warframes.description: Sevagoth's roving spirit, formed from concentrated Void energy.

warframes.name: Stalker
warframes.description: An ally from an unknown time and place. Stalker is a powerful force within the shadows.

warframes.name: Styanax
warframes.description: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.

warframes.name: Temple
warframes.description: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie. Temple's power chords light the flames of revolution.

warframes.name: Titania
warframes.description: Titania's fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.

warframes.name: Trinity
warframes.description: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.

warframes.name: Valkyr
warframes.description: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.

warframes.name: Vauban
warframes.description: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.

warframes.name: Volt
warframes.description: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.

warframes.name: Voruna
warframes.description: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.

warframes.name: Wisp
warframes.description: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.

warframes.name: Wukong
warframes.description: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.

warframes.name: Xaku
warframes.description: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.

warframes.name: Yareli
warframes.description: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.

warframes.name: Zephyr
warframes.description: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr's cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.

weapons.name: Acceltra Prime
weapons.description: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.

weapons.name: Afentis Prime
weapons.description: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.

weapons.name: Alternox Prime
weapons.description: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.

weapons.name: Astilla Prime
weapons.description: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.

weapons.name: Baza Prime
weapons.description: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.

weapons.name: Boar Prime
weapons.description: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.

weapons.name: Boltor Prime
weapons.description: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.

weapons.name: Braton Prime
weapons.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.

weapons.name: Burston Prime
weapons.description: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.

weapons.name: Cedo Prime
weapons.description: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.

weapons.name: Cernos Prime
weapons.description: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.

weapons.name: Corinth Prime
weapons.description: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.

weapons.name: Daikyu Prime
weapons.description: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.

weapons.name: Fulmin Prime
weapons.description: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.

weapons.name: Gotva Prime
weapons.description: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.

weapons.name: Latron Prime
weapons.description: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.

weapons.name: Nagantaka Prime
weapons.description: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.

weapons.name: Panthera Prime
weapons.description: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.

weapons.name: Paris Prime
weapons.description: Discovered deep inside an ancient Orokin derelict, the Paris Prime increases the kinetic energy of any bolt it fires, dealing more damage than its more common counterpart.

weapons.name: Perigale Prime
weapons.description: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.

weapons.name: Phantasma Prime
weapons.description: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.

weapons.name: Rubico Prime
weapons.description: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.

weapons.name: Scourge Prime
weapons.description: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.

weapons.name: Soma Prime
weapons.description: Known for taking down whole squads with its single massive magazine, few weapons were as feared as the Prime Soma.

weapons.name: Stradavar Prime
weapons.description: Between measured staccato and staggering crescendo, Stradavar Prime never fails to call down a devastating finale.

weapons.name: Strun Prime
weapons.description: A classic shotgun design, embellished for the elite as only the Orokin could.

weapons.name: Sybaris Prime
weapons.description: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.

weapons.name: Tenora Prime
weapons.description: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.

weapons.name: Tiberon Prime
weapons.description: Art meets ingenuity with this beautifully deadly rifle.

weapons.name: Tigris Prime
weapons.description: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.

weapons.name: Trumna Prime
weapons.description: Sleek lines and golden accents define this masterpiece of the illustrious Entrati family.

weapons.name: Vadarya Prime
weapons.description: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Vectis Prime
weapons.description: Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.

weapons.name: Zhuge Prime
weapons.description: Tenno artistry. Ancient craft. A weapon of surgical precision and devastating effect. Each bolt fired by Zhuge Prime explodes shortly after embedding.

weapons.name: Acceltra
weapons.description: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.

weapons.name: Aeolak
weapons.description: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.

weapons.name: Afentis
weapons.description: Styanax’s speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.

weapons.name: Alternox
weapons.description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.

weapons.name: Ambassador
weapons.description: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.

weapons.name: Amprex
weapons.description: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.

weapons.name: Arca Plasmor
weapons.description: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

weapons.name: Argonak
weapons.description: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.

weapons.name: Astilla
weapons.description: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.

weapons.name: Attica
weapons.description: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.

weapons.name: AX-52
weapons.description: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.

weapons.name: Basmu
weapons.description: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.

weapons.name: Battacor
weapons.description: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.

weapons.name: Baza
weapons.description: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.

weapons.name: Boar
weapons.description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.

weapons.name: Boltor
weapons.description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

weapons.name: Braton
weapons.description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.

weapons.name: Braton Vandal
weapons.description: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

weapons.name: Bubonico
weapons.description: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.

weapons.name: Burston
weapons.description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.

weapons.name: Buzlok
weapons.description: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.

weapons.name: Carmine Penta
weapons.description: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.

weapons.name: Cedo
weapons.description: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire’s precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.

weapons.name: Cernos
weapons.description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.

weapons.name: Cinta
weapons.description: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.

weapons.name: Coda Bassocyst
weapons.description: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.

weapons.name: Coda Bubonico
weapons.description: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.

weapons.name: Coda Hema
weapons.description: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

weapons.name: Coda Sporothrix
weapons.description: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.

weapons.name: Coda Synapse
weapons.description: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.

weapons.name: Convectrix
weapons.description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.

weapons.name: Corinth
weapons.description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Daikyu
weapons.description: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.

weapons.name: Dera
weapons.description: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.

weapons.name: Dera Vandal
weapons.description: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.

weapons.name: Dex Sybaris
weapons.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

weapons.name: Drakgoon
weapons.description: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

weapons.name: Dread
weapons.description: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.

weapons.name: EFV-5 Jupiter
weapons.description: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.

weapons.name: Enkaus
weapons.description: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.

weapons.name: Evensong
weapons.description: Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot. Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

weapons.name: Exergis
weapons.description: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.

weapons.name: Felarx
weapons.description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

weapons.name: Ferrox
weapons.description: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.

weapons.name: Flux Rifle
weapons.description: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.

weapons.name: Fulmin
weapons.description: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.

weapons.name: Glaxion
weapons.description: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.

weapons.name: Glaxion Vandal
weapons.description: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.

weapons.name: Gorgon
weapons.description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.

weapons.name: Gorgon Wraith
weapons.description: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.

weapons.name: Grakata
weapons.description: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.

weapons.name: Grinlok
weapons.description: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.

weapons.name: Haalvu
weapons.description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.

weapons.name: Harpak
weapons.description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.

weapons.name: Hek
weapons.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.

weapons.name: Hema
weapons.description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.

weapons.name: Higasa
weapons.description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.

weapons.name: Hind
weapons.description: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.

weapons.name: Ignis
weapons.description: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.

weapons.name: Ignis Wraith
weapons.description: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.

weapons.name: Javlok
weapons.description: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.

weapons.name: Karak
weapons.description: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.

weapons.name: Karak Wraith
weapons.description: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.

weapons.name: Kohm
weapons.description: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

weapons.name: Komorex
weapons.description: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.

weapons.name: Kuva Bramma
weapons.description: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.

weapons.name: Kuva Chakkhurr
weapons.description: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.

weapons.name: Kuva Drakgoon
weapons.description: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

weapons.name: Kuva Hek
weapons.description: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.

weapons.name: Kuva Hind
weapons.description: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.

weapons.name: Kuva Karak
weapons.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.

weapons.name: Kuva Kohm
weapons.description: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

weapons.name: Kuva Ogris
weapons.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.

weapons.name: Kuva Quartakk
weapons.description: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.

weapons.name: Kuva Sobek
weapons.description: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.

weapons.name: Kuva Tonkor
weapons.description: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.

weapons.name: Kuva Zarr
weapons.description: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.

weapons.name: Lanka
weapons.description: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.

weapons.name: Latron
weapons.description: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.

weapons.name: Latron Wraith
weapons.description: The Latron Wraith is a powerful variation of the standard, semi-automatic rifle that features unique styling.

weapons.name: Lenz
weapons.description: Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.

weapons.name: Miter
weapons.description: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.

weapons.name: MK1-Braton
weapons.description: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.

weapons.name: MK1-Paris
weapons.description: The MK1-Paris is the standard issue bow for all Tenno.

weapons.name: MK1-Strun
weapons.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

weapons.name: Mutalist Cernos
weapons.description: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.

weapons.name: Mutalist Quanta
weapons.description: A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.

weapons.name: Nagantaka
weapons.description: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.

weapons.name: Nataruk
weapons.description: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.

weapons.name: Ogris
weapons.description: Ogris fires detonite-infused casings.

weapons.name: Opticor
weapons.description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.

weapons.name: Opticor Vandal
weapons.description: With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.

weapons.name: Panthera
weapons.description: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.

weapons.name: Paracyst
weapons.description: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.

weapons.name: Paris
weapons.description: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.

weapons.name: Penta
weapons.description: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.

weapons.name: Perigale
weapons.description: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession increase the Perigale's ammo efficiency. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.

weapons.name: Phage
weapons.description: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.

weapons.name: Phantasma
weapons.description: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.

weapons.name: Phenmor
weapons.description: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.

weapons.name: Prisma Gorgon
weapons.description: Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.

weapons.name: Prisma Grakata
weapons.description: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.

weapons.name: Prisma Grinlok
weapons.description: Prisma-crystal enhancement creates here a prestige instrument; a weapon capable of taking life at astonishing range with but a single pull of its exquisitely-tooled trigger.

weapons.name: Prisma Lenz
weapons.description: The explosive potential of the Lenz, enhanced with Prisma crystals.

weapons.name: Prisma Tetra
weapons.description: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.

weapons.name: Proboscis Cernos
weapons.description: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.

weapons.name: Purgator 1
weapons.description: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.

weapons.name: Quanta
weapons.description: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.

weapons.name: Quanta Vandal
weapons.description: A customized version of the Quanta, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

weapons.name: Quartakk
weapons.description: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.

weapons.name: Quellor
weapons.description: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.

weapons.name: Rakta Cernos
weapons.description: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.

weapons.name: Rauta
weapons.description: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.

weapons.name: Reconifex
weapons.description: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.

weapons.name: Rubico
weapons.description: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.

weapons.name: Sancti Tigris
weapons.description: Echo nature's violent beauty with this special Tigris.

weapons.name: Scourge
weapons.description: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.

weapons.name: Secura Penta
weapons.description: Ruthless and efficient, just like the free-market.

weapons.name: Shedu
weapons.description: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.

weapons.name: Simulor
weapons.description: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.

weapons.name: Snipetron
weapons.description: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.

weapons.name: Snipetron Vandal
weapons.description: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

weapons.name: Sobek
weapons.description: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.

weapons.name: Soma
weapons.description: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.

weapons.name: Sporothrix
weapons.description: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.

weapons.name: Stahlta
weapons.description: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.

weapons.name: Steflos
weapons.description: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.

weapons.name: Stradavar
weapons.description: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.

weapons.name: Strun
weapons.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

weapons.name: Strun Wraith
weapons.description: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.

weapons.name: Supra
weapons.description: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.

weapons.name: Supra Vandal
weapons.description: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.

weapons.name: Sybaris
weapons.description: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.

weapons.name: Synapse
weapons.description: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of Corrosive energy.

weapons.name: Synoid Simulor
weapons.description: Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.

weapons.name: Telos Boltor
weapons.description: Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.

weapons.name: Tenet Arca Plasmor
weapons.description: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

weapons.name: Tenet Envoy
weapons.description: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.

weapons.name: Tenet Ferrox
weapons.description: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.

weapons.name: Tenet Flux Rifle
weapons.description: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.

weapons.name: Tenet Glaxion
weapons.description: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.

weapons.name: Tenet Quanta
weapons.description: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.

weapons.name: Tenet Tetra
weapons.description: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.

weapons.name: Tenora
weapons.description: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.

weapons.name: Tetra
weapons.description: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.

weapons.name: Thornbak
weapons.description: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.

weapons.name: Tiberon
weapons.description: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.

weapons.name: Tigris
weapons.description: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.

weapons.name: Tonkor
weapons.description: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.

weapons.name: Torid
weapons.description: Torid lobs a toxic payload.

weapons.name: Trumna
weapons.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.

weapons.name: Vaykor Hek
weapons.description: Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.

weapons.name: Vectis
weapons.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.

weapons.name: Veldt
weapons.description: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.

weapons.name: Vinquibus
weapons.description: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.

weapons.name: Vulkar
weapons.description: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.

weapons.name: Vulkar Wraith
weapons.description: A blood-red variant of this devastating sniper rifle.

weapons.name: Zarr
weapons.description: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.

weapons.name: Zenith
weapons.description: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.

weapons.name: Zhuge
weapons.description: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.

weapons.name: Afuris Prime
weapons.description: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.

weapons.name: Akarius Prime
weapons.description: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.

weapons.name: Akbolto Prime
weapons.description: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.

weapons.name: Akbronco Prime
weapons.description: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.

weapons.name: Akjagara Prime
weapons.description: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.

weapons.name: Aklex Prime
weapons.description: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.

weapons.name: Akmagnus Prime
weapons.description: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.

weapons.name: Aksomati Prime
weapons.description: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.

weapons.name: Akstiletto Prime
weapons.description: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.

weapons.name: Akvasto Prime
weapons.description: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.

weapons.name: Athodai Prime
weapons.description: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on headshot kills, maximizing fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

weapons.name: Ballistica Prime
weapons.description: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.

weapons.name: Bronco Prime
weapons.description: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.

weapons.name: Epitaph Prime
weapons.description: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.

weapons.name: Euphona Prime
weapons.description: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.

weapons.name: Hikou Prime
weapons.description: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.

weapons.name: Hystrix Prime
weapons.description: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.

weapons.name: Knell Prime
weapons.description: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.

weapons.name: Kompressa Prime
weapons.description: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.

weapons.name: Lato Prime
weapons.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

weapons.name: Lex Prime
weapons.description: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

weapons.name: Magnus Prime
weapons.description: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to maximize Ammo Efficiency for a few seconds.

weapons.name: Pandero Prime
weapons.description: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.

weapons.name: Pyrana Prime
weapons.description: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.

weapons.name: Sagek Prime
weapons.description: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.

weapons.name: Sicarus Prime
weapons.description: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

weapons.name: Spira Prime
weapons.description: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.

weapons.name: Vasto Prime
weapons.description: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.

weapons.name: Velox Prime
weapons.description: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.

weapons.name: Zakti Prime
weapons.description: A thousand pains, before their end.

weapons.name: Zylok Prime
weapons.description: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.

weapons.name: Acrid
weapons.description: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.

weapons.name: Aegrit
weapons.description: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.

weapons.name: Afuris
weapons.description: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.

weapons.name: Akarius
weapons.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.

weapons.name: Akbolto
weapons.description: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.

weapons.name: Akbronco
weapons.description: A Bronco equipped in each hand.

weapons.name: Akjagara
weapons.description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.

weapons.name: Aklato
weapons.description: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.

weapons.name: Aklex
weapons.description: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.

weapons.name: Akmagnus
weapons.description: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.

weapons.name: Aksomati
weapons.description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.

weapons.name: Akstiletto
weapons.description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.

weapons.name: Akvasto
weapons.description: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.

weapons.name: Akzani
weapons.description: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.

weapons.name: Angstrum
weapons.description: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.

weapons.name: Arca Scisco
weapons.description: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.

weapons.name: Athodai
weapons.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

weapons.name: Atomos
weapons.description: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.

weapons.name: Azima
weapons.description: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Ballistica
weapons.description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.

weapons.name: Bolto
weapons.description: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

weapons.name: Brakk
weapons.description: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.

weapons.name: Bronco
weapons.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.

weapons.name: Cantare
weapons.description: In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed. Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

weapons.name: Castanas
weapons.description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.

weapons.name: Catabolyst
weapons.description: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.

weapons.name: Cestra
weapons.description: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.

weapons.name: Coda Catabolyst
weapons.description: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.

weapons.name: Coda Pox
weapons.description: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

weapons.name: Coda Tysis
weapons.description: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.

weapons.name: Cyanex
weapons.description: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.

weapons.name: Cycron
weapons.description: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.

weapons.name: Despair
weapons.description: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.

weapons.name: Detron
weapons.description: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.

weapons.name: Dex Furis
weapons.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

weapons.name: Dual Cestra
weapons.description: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.

weapons.name: Dual Coda Torxica
weapons.description: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.

weapons.name: Dual Toxocyst
weapons.description: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.

weapons.name: EFV-8 Mars
weapons.description: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.

weapons.name: Embolist
weapons.description: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.

weapons.name: Epitaph
weapons.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

weapons.name: Furis
weapons.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.

weapons.name: Fusilai
weapons.description: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.

weapons.name: Gammacor
weapons.description: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.

weapons.name: Grimoire
weapons.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed Electricity Status.

weapons.name: Grimoire
weapons.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed Electricity Status.

weapons.name: Hikou
weapons.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

weapons.name: Hystrix
weapons.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.

weapons.name: Knell
weapons.description: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.

weapons.name: Kohmak
weapons.description: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.

weapons.name: Kompressa
weapons.description: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.

weapons.name: Kraken
weapons.description: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.

weapons.name: Kulstar
weapons.description: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.

weapons.name: Kunai
weapons.description: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.

weapons.name: Kuva Brakk
weapons.description: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.

weapons.name: Kuva Kraken
weapons.description: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.

weapons.name: Kuva Nukor
weapons.description: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.

weapons.name: Kuva Seer
weapons.description: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.

weapons.name: Kuva Twin Stubbas
weapons.description: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.

weapons.name: Laetum
weapons.description: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.

weapons.name: Lato
weapons.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.

weapons.name: Lato Vandal
weapons.description: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

weapons.name: Lex
weapons.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

weapons.name: Magnus
weapons.description: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.

weapons.name: Mara Detron
weapons.description: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.

weapons.name: Marelok
weapons.description: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.

weapons.name: MK1-Furis
weapons.description: The MK1-Furis are the standard issue automatic pistol for all Tenno.

weapons.name: MK1-Kunai
weapons.description: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.

weapons.name: Nukor
weapons.description: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.

weapons.name: Ocucor
weapons.description: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.

weapons.name: Onos
weapons.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of Heat.

weapons.name: Pandero
weapons.description: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.

weapons.name: Plinx
weapons.description: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.

weapons.name: Pox
weapons.description: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.

weapons.name: Prisma Angstrum
weapons.description: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.

weapons.name: Prisma Twin Gremlins
weapons.description: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.

weapons.name: Pyrana
weapons.description: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.

weapons.name: Quatz
weapons.description: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.

weapons.name: Rakta Ballistica
weapons.description: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.

weapons.name: Riot-848
weapons.description: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.

weapons.name: Sancti Castanas
weapons.description: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.

weapons.name: Scyotid
weapons.description: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.

weapons.name: Secura Dual Cestra
weapons.description: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.

weapons.name: Seer
weapons.description: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.

weapons.name: Sepulcrum
weapons.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.

weapons.name: Sicarus
weapons.description: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

weapons.name: Sonicor
weapons.description: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.

weapons.name: Spectra
weapons.description: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.

weapons.name: Spectra Vandal
weapons.description: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.

weapons.name: Spira
weapons.description: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.

weapons.name: Staticor
weapons.description: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.

weapons.name: Stubba
weapons.description: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.

weapons.name: Stug
weapons.description: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.

weapons.name: Synoid Gammacor
weapons.description: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.

weapons.name: Talons
weapons.description: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.

weapons.name: Telos Akbolto
weapons.description: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.

weapons.name: Tenet Cycron
weapons.description: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.

weapons.name: Tenet Detron
weapons.description: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.

weapons.name: Tenet Diplos
weapons.description: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.

weapons.name: Tenet Plinx
weapons.description: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.

weapons.name: Tenet Spirex
weapons.description: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.

weapons.name: Twin Grakatas
weapons.description: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.

weapons.name: Twin Gremlins
weapons.description: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.

weapons.name: Twin Kohmak
weapons.description: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.

weapons.name: Twin Rogga
weapons.description: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.

weapons.name: Twin Vipers
weapons.description: A Viper equipped in each hand.
