weapons.name: Twin Vipers Wraith
weapons.description: The uniquely styled Twin Vipers Wraith are a powerful variation on the standard akimbo machine-pistols.

weapons.name: Tysis
weapons.description: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.

weapons.name: Vasto
weapons.description: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.

weapons.name: Vaykor Marelok
weapons.description: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.

weapons.name: Velox
weapons.description: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.

weapons.name: Vesper 77
weapons.description: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.

weapons.name: Viper
weapons.description: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.

weapons.name: Viper Wraith
weapons.description: The uniquely styled Viper Wraith is a powerful variation on the standard machine-pistol.

weapons.name: Zakti
weapons.description: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.

weapons.name: Zylok
weapons.description: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.

weapons.name: Zymos
weapons.description: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Ankyros Prime
weapons.description: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.

weapons.name: Bo Prime
weapons.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.

weapons.name: Cobra & Crane Prime
weapons.description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

weapons.name: Dakra Prime
weapons.description: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.

weapons.name: Destreza Prime
weapons.description: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.

weapons.name: Dual Kamas Prime
weapons.description: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.

weapons.name: Dual Keres Prime
weapons.description: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.

weapons.name: Dual Zoren Prime
weapons.description: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.

weapons.name: Fang Prime
weapons.description: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.

weapons.name: Fragor Prime
weapons.description: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.

weapons.name: Galariak Prime
weapons.description: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.

weapons.name: Galatine Prime
weapons.description: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.

weapons.name: Glaive Prime
weapons.description: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

weapons.name: Gram Prime
weapons.description: Born anew, the father of swords returns.

weapons.name: Guandao Prime
weapons.description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

weapons.name: Gunsen Prime
weapons.description: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.

weapons.name: Karyst Prime
weapons.description: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.

weapons.name: Kestrel Prime
weapons.description: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.

weapons.name: Kogake Prime
weapons.description: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.

weapons.name: Kronen Prime
weapons.description: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.

weapons.name: Masseter Prime
weapons.description: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.

weapons.name: Nami Skyla Prime
weapons.description: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.

weapons.name: Nikana Prime
weapons.description: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.

weapons.name: Ninkondi Prime
weapons.description: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.

weapons.name: Okina Prime
weapons.description: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.

weapons.name: Orthos Prime
weapons.description: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.

weapons.name: Pangolin Prime
weapons.description: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.

weapons.name: Quassus Prime
weapons.description: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.

weapons.name: Reaper Prime
weapons.description: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.

weapons.name: Redeemer Prime
weapons.description: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.

weapons.name: Sarofang Prime
weapons.description: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.

weapons.name: Scindo Prime
weapons.description: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.

weapons.name: Silva & Aegis Prime
weapons.description: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.

weapons.name: Skana Prime
weapons.description: A basic blade known as a Skana. It is widely used by the Tenno. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

weapons.name: Tatsu Prime
weapons.description: Tatsu Prime glows with spectral splendor. It grows more powerful with each enemy’s demise, especially when wielded by Revenant.

weapons.name: Tekko Prime
weapons.description: As merciless and indestructible as Atlas Prime himself, Tekko Prime crush and split with tectonic force.

weapons.name: Tipedo Prime
weapons.description: With their final breath they look to the moon, and are gone.

weapons.name: Venato Prime
weapons.description: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against “common enemies” of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.

weapons.name: Venka Prime
weapons.description: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.

weapons.name: Volnus Prime
weapons.description: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.

weapons.name: War Prime
weapons.description: The blade of the world-destroyer reaches its apotheosis, severing conflict itself. In forging this weapon, you have brought unrealized dreams to their ultimate conclusion.

weapons.name: Ack & Brunt
weapons.description: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.

weapons.name: Amanata
weapons.description: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.

weapons.name: Amphis
weapons.description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.

weapons.name: Anku
weapons.description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.

weapons.name: Ankyros
weapons.description: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.

weapons.name: Arca Titron
weapons.description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.

weapons.name: Argo & Vel
weapons.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

weapons.name: Arum Spinosa
weapons.description: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.

weapons.name: Atterax
weapons.description: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.

weapons.name: Azothane
weapons.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

weapons.name: Bo
weapons.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.

weapons.name: Boltace
weapons.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

weapons.name: Broken Scepter
weapons.description: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.

weapons.name: Broken War
weapons.description: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.

weapons.name: Cadus
weapons.description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

weapons.name: Cassowar
weapons.description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

weapons.name: Caustacyst
weapons.description: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

weapons.name: Ceramic Dagger
weapons.description: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

weapons.name: Cerata
weapons.description: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.

weapons.name: Ceti Lacera
weapons.description: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.

weapons.name: Cobra & Crane
weapons.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

weapons.name: Coda Caustacyst
weapons.description: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.

weapons.name: Coda Hirudo
weapons.description: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

weapons.name: Coda Mire
weapons.description: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

weapons.name: Coda Motovore
weapons.description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

weapons.name: Coda Pathocyst
weapons.description: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.

weapons.name: Corufell
weapons.description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.

weapons.name: Cronus
weapons.description: A strong blade forged using ceramic.

weapons.name: Dark Dagger
weapons.description: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.

weapons.name: Dark Split-Sword
weapons.description: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.

weapons.name: Dark Sword
weapons.description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate Radiation Damage with attacks.

weapons.name: Destreza
weapons.description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.

weapons.name: Dex Dakra
weapons.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

weapons.name: Dex Nikana
weapons.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

weapons.name: Dorrclave
weapons.description: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.

weapons.name: Dragon Nikana
weapons.description: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.

weapons.name: Dual Cleavers
weapons.description: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.

weapons.name: Dual Ether
weapons.description: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.

weapons.name: Dual Heat Swords
weapons.description: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

weapons.name: Dual Ichor
weapons.description: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.

weapons.name: Dual Kamas
weapons.description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.

weapons.name: Dual Keres
weapons.description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.

weapons.name: Dual Raza
weapons.description: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.

weapons.name: Dual Skana
weapons.description: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

weapons.name: Dual Viciss
weapons.description: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.

weapons.name: Dual Zoren
weapons.description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

weapons.name: Edun
weapons.description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

weapons.name: Ekhein
weapons.description: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.

weapons.name: Endura
weapons.description: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.

weapons.name: Ether Daggers
weapons.description: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.

weapons.name: Ether Reaper
weapons.description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

weapons.name: Ether Sword
weapons.description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing’ infested allies.

weapons.name: Falcor
weapons.description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.

weapons.name: Fang
weapons.description: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.

weapons.name: Fragor
weapons.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

weapons.name: Furax
weapons.description: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.

weapons.name: Furax Wraith
weapons.description: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.

weapons.name: Galatine
weapons.description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.

weapons.name: Galvacord
weapons.description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.

weapons.name: Gazal Machete
weapons.description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of Corrosive Damage.

weapons.name: Ghoulsaw
weapons.description: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.

weapons.name: Gram
weapons.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

weapons.name: Guandao
weapons.description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.

weapons.name: Gunsen
weapons.description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

weapons.name: Halikar
weapons.description: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.

weapons.name: Halikar Wraith
weapons.description: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.

weapons.name: Harmony
weapons.description: Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration. Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

weapons.name: Hate
weapons.description: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.

weapons.name: Heat Dagger
weapons.description: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.

weapons.name: Heat Sword
weapons.description: A strong blade capable of inflicting Slash Damage to its foes.

weapons.name: Heliocor
weapons.description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

weapons.name: Hespar
weapons.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

weapons.name: Hirudo
weapons.description: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.

weapons.name: Innodem
weapons.description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

weapons.name: Jat Kittag
weapons.description: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

weapons.name: Jat Kusar
weapons.description: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.

weapons.name: Jaw Sword
weapons.description: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.

weapons.name: Kama
weapons.description: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.

weapons.name: Karyst
weapons.description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.

weapons.name: Keratinos
weapons.description: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.

weapons.name: Kesheg
weapons.description: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.

weapons.name: Kestrel
weapons.description: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.

weapons.name: Kogake
weapons.description: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.

weapons.name: Korrudo
weapons.description: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.

weapons.name: Korumm
weapons.description: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.

weapons.name: Kreska
weapons.description: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.

weapons.name: Krohkur
weapons.description: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.

weapons.name: Kronen
weapons.description: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.

weapons.name: Kuva Ghoulsaw
weapons.description: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.

weapons.name: Kuva Shildeg
weapons.description: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.

weapons.name: Lacera
weapons.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.

weapons.name: Lecta
weapons.description: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.

weapons.name: Lesion
weapons.description: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased Toxin Damage.

weapons.name: Machete
weapons.description: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.

weapons.name: Machete Wraith
weapons.description: A different take on a familiar combat knife, the Machete Wraith features unique styling.

weapons.name: Magistar
weapons.description: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.

weapons.name: Masseter
weapons.description: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.

weapons.name: Mios
weapons.description: This bone-forged sword includes a tendon-whip to distract and maim the enemy.

weapons.name: Mire
weapons.description: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.

weapons.name: MK1-Bo
weapons.description: The MK1-Bo is the standard issue staff weapon for all Tenno.

weapons.name: MK1-Furax
weapons.description: The MK1-Furax is the standard issue fist weapon for all Tenno.

weapons.name: Nami Skyla
weapons.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.

weapons.name: Nami Solo
weapons.description: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.

weapons.name: Nepheri
weapons.description: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.

weapons.name: Nikana
weapons.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.

weapons.name: Ninkondi
weapons.description: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.

weapons.name: Obex
weapons.description: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.

weapons.name: Ohma
weapons.description: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.

weapons.name: Okina
weapons.description: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.

weapons.name: Orthos
weapons.description: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.

weapons.name: Orvius
weapons.description: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.

weapons.name: Pangolin Sword
weapons.description: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.

weapons.name: Paracesis
weapons.description: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.

weapons.name: Pathocyst
weapons.description: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.

weapons.name: Pennant
weapons.description: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.

weapons.name: Plasma Sword
weapons.description: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

weapons.name: Praedos
weapons.description: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.

weapons.name: Pride
weapons.description: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.

weapons.name: Prisma Dual Cleavers
weapons.description: Blades of energized prisma crystal make these ornamental cleavers cut as sharply as they look.

weapons.name: Prisma Machete
weapons.description: The addition of Prisma Crystal allows this otherwise barbaric weapon to elegantly hack through any foe.

weapons.name: Prisma Obex
weapons.description: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.

weapons.name: Prisma Ohma
weapons.description: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.

weapons.name: Prisma Skana
weapons.description: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.

weapons.name: Prova
weapons.description: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.

weapons.name: Prova Vandal
weapons.description: A customized version of the vicious Prova, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

weapons.name: Pulmonars
weapons.description: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.

weapons.name: Pupacyst
weapons.description: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.

weapons.name: Quassus
weapons.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.

weapons.name: Rakta Dark Dagger
weapons.description: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.

weapons.name: Redeemer
weapons.description: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.

weapons.name: Ripkas
weapons.description: Motorized saw claw weapon.

weapons.name: Rumblejack
weapons.description: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.

weapons.name: Ruvox
weapons.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.

weapons.name: Sampotes
weapons.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

weapons.name: Sancti Magistar
weapons.description: Each charged attack turns the enemy’s pain into a healing pulse that washes over allies. Also, creates resistance to Status Effects when held.

weapons.name: Sarofang
weapons.description: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.

weapons.name: Sarpa
weapons.description: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.

weapons.name: Scindo
weapons.description: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.

weapons.name: Scoliac
weapons.description: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping Toxin Damage with attacks.

weapons.name: Secura Lecta
weapons.description: Whip the enemy out of their ill-gotten gains; double credit drops on kills.

weapons.name: Serro
weapons.description: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.

weapons.name: Shaku
weapons.description: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.

weapons.name: Sheev
weapons.description: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.

weapons.name: Sibear
weapons.description: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.

weapons.name: Sigma & Octantis
weapons.description: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.

weapons.name: Silva & Aegis
weapons.description: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.

weapons.name: Skana
weapons.description: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.

weapons.name: Skiajati
weapons.description: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.

weapons.name: Slaytra
weapons.description: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of Slash Status Effects.

weapons.name: Spinnerex
weapons.description: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.

weapons.name: Stropha
weapons.description: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.

weapons.name: Sun & Moon
weapons.description: Teshin's twin blades.

weapons.name: Syam
weapons.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

weapons.name: Sydon
weapons.description: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.

weapons.name: Synoid Heliocor
weapons.description: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.

weapons.name: Tak & Lug
weapons.description: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.

weapons.name: Tatsu
weapons.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.

weapons.name: Tekko
weapons.description: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.

weapons.name: Telos Boltace
weapons.description: Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.

weapons.name: Tenet Agendus
weapons.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.

weapons.name: Tenet Exec
weapons.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

weapons.name: Tenet Grigori
weapons.description: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

weapons.name: Tenet Livia
weapons.description: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

weapons.name: Thalys
weapons.description: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.

weapons.name: Tipedo
weapons.description: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.

weapons.name: Tonbo
weapons.description: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.

weapons.name: Tonkkatt
weapons.description: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.

weapons.name: Twin Basolk
weapons.description: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.

weapons.name: Twin Krohkur
weapons.description: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.

weapons.name: Vastilok
weapons.description: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.

weapons.name: Vaykor Sydon
weapons.description: Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.

weapons.name: Venato
weapons.description: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.

weapons.name: Venka
weapons.description: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.

weapons.name: Verdilac
weapons.description: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.

weapons.name: Vericres
weapons.description: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.

weapons.name: Vitrica
weapons.description: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.

weapons.name: Volnus
weapons.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

weapons.name: War
weapons.description: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.

weapons.name: Wolf Sledge
weapons.description: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.

weapons.name: Wrath
weapons.description: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.

weapons.name: Xoris
weapons.description: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.

weapons.name: Zenistar
weapons.description: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.

mods.name: Abating Link
mods.description: Link Augment: Reduces Armor Rating by 60% on enemies targeted by Link.
mods.effect: Link Augment: Reduces Armor Rating by 60% on enemies targeted by Link.

mods.name: Abundant Mutation
mods.description: Passive Augment: Nidus gains an additional 200 max stacks of Mutation. Undying has a 30s cooldown.
mods.effect: Passive Augment: Nidus gains an additional 200 max stacks of Mutation. Undying has a 30s cooldown.

mods.name: Accumulating Whipclaw
mods.description: Whipclaw Augment: Hitting 3 enemies will grant a 35% stacking Damage Bonus to subsequent Whipclaws. Bonus will decay after 10s.
mods.effect: Whipclaw Augment: Hitting 3 enemies will grant a 35% stacking Damage Bonus to subsequent Whipclaws. Bonus will decay after 10s.

mods.effect: When Damaged:\n+10% Resistance to that Damage Type for 20s. Stacks up to 90%.

mods.name: Adept Surge
mods.description: +10% Mobility · -25 Health

mods.name: Adrenaline Boost
mods.description: +50% Energy · -20% Health

mods.name: Aegis Gale

mods.effect: Aegis Storm Augment: Balefire has an Alternate Fire during Aegis Storm. The blast deals 15% of Hildryn's Max Shield as additional damage.

mods.name: Aero Vantage
mods.description: -100% Gravity while Aim Gliding

mods.name: Aerodynamic
mods.description: Squad takes 24% reduced damage while airborne, gains +6s Aim Glide and +12s Wall Latch
mods.effect: Squad takes 24% reduced damage while airborne, gains +6s Aim Glide and +12s Wall Latch

mods.description: Spectral Scream Augment: Upon deactivation, Chroma will launch an elemental projectile dealing 100 Damage for each second the ability was active, to a maximum of 500 Damage.
mods.effect: Spectral Scream Augment: Upon deactivation, Chroma will launch an elemental projectile dealing 100 Damage for each second the ability was active, to a maximum of 500 Damage.

mods.name: Agility Drift
mods.description: Reduced damage by 12% while airborne · -6% Enemy Accuracy when targeting Warframe
mods.effect: Reduced damage by 12% while airborne · -6% Enemy Accuracy when targeting Warframe

mods.name: Air Thrusters
mods.description: +100% Slide Boost when Airborne · -20% Mobility

mods.name: Airburst Rounds
mods.description: Airburst Augment: Each enemy hit by Airburst increases secondary damage by 40% for 14s.
mods.effect: Airburst Augment: Each enemy hit by Airburst increases secondary damage by 40% for 14s.

mods.name: Amar’s Anguish
mods.description: +15% to Parkour Velocity · +15% Sprint Speed

mods.name: Amar’s Hatred
mods.description: +25% Armor · +15% Ability Strength

mods.name: Ambush
mods.description: When Ghost invisibility is broken, Shade's owner is granted +240% Weapon Damage for 3s.
mods.effect: When Ghost invisibility is broken, Shade's owner is granted +240% Weapon Damage for 3s.

mods.name: Anchored Glide
mods.description: Disable Zephyr's reduced airborne gravity. Increase Ability Strength by 15%.
mods.effect: Disable Zephyr's reduced airborne gravity. Increase Ability Strength by 15%.

mods.name: Anti-Flak Plating
mods.description: +20 Blast Resistance · -10% Mobility

mods.name: Anticipation
mods.description: Immune to Knockdown for an additional +4s after being knocked down. · Immune to Stagger for an additional +4s after being Staggered.
mods.effect: Immune to Knockdown for an additional +4s after being knocked down. · Immune to Stagger for an additional +4s after being Staggered.

mods.name: Antimatter Absorb
mods.description: Antimatter Drop Augment: Absorbs enemy bullets within 5m, increasing the power of the explosion from Nova’s particle of antimatter.
mods.effect: Antimatter Drop Augment: Absorbs enemy bullets within 5m, increasing the power of the explosion from Nova’s particle of antimatter.

mods.name: Antimatter Mine
mods.description: Antimatter Drop Augment: Creates a fully charged stationary orb that explodes after 6s or within enemy proximity.
mods.effect: Antimatter Drop Augment: Creates a fully charged stationary orb that explodes after 6s or within enemy proximity.

mods.name: Antitoxin
mods.description: +82.5% Toxin Resistance

mods.name: Archon Continuity
mods.description: +55% Ability Duration · Abilities that inflict a Toxin status effect will also apply a Corrosive status effect.

companions.name: Huras Kubrow
companions.description: Prized for its ability to sneak up on unsuspecting prey, the Huras Kubrow were first used as hunting companions by the Orokin elite. Orokin Era Tenno soon adapted the strain for use in covert missions and assassinations.

companions.name: Raksa Kubrow
companions.description: Designed by the Orokin to be the perfect companion, a Kubrow was never far from its master's side. Loyal and obedient, these creatures made ideal bodyguards. Equipped with shield generators for added protection, their fierce growl could paralyze any attacker with fear.

companions.name: Sahasa Kubrow
companions.description: Enterprising Orokin genetic designers recognized that the Kubrow's affinity for games of fetch could be used for more serious endeavors. They soon developed a strain adept at reconnaissance and contraband recovery. Tenno often used the creatures to help resupply while in the field.

companions.name: Smeeta Kavat

companions.name: Sunika Kubrow
companions.description: Once the value of Orokin guard-pets had been realized, Orokin scientists began experimenting with strains designed for combat. These were no longer household pets but superior war animals bred for ferocity and aggression.

companions.name: Vasca Kavat

companions.name: Venari

companions.name: Carrier Prime
companions.description: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.

companions.name: Dethcube Prime
companions.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Helios Prime
companions.description: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.

companions.name: Nautilus Prime
companions.description: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.

companions.name: Shade Prime
companions.description: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime.\r\n\r\nTogether, you can dominate the shadows.

companions.name: Wyrm Prime
companions.description: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.

companions.name: Carrier
companions.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Dethcube
companions.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Diriga
companions.description: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Djinn
companions.description: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Helios
companions.description: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Nautilus
companions.description: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Oxylus
companions.description: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Prisma Shade
companions.description: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?

companions.name: Shade
companions.description: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Taxon
companions.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.

companions.name: Wyrm
companions.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.\r\n\r\nNote: This item requires two open slots.
